targets.old_statement: The opening-period curfew runs 10 p.m. to 5 a.m. every night, while the later under-18 limits change by day: after 11 p.m. on Sunday to Thursday nights and from 1 a.m. to 5 a.m. on weekend nights.
targets.old_spoken_statement: The opening-period curfew runs ten p.m. to five a.m. every night, while the later under-eighteen limits change by day: after eleven p.m. on Sunday to Thursday nights and from one a.m. to five a.m. on weekend nights.
targets.statement: During the first one hundred eighty days, probationary drivers cannot drive from ten p.m. to five a.m.; afterward while under eighteen, driving is barred after eleven p.m. Sunday through Thursday, before five a.m. Monday through Friday, and from one a.m. to five a.m. Saturday and Sunday unless traveling for lawful work, a school-sanctioned activity, or a religious event, or riding with a qualifying licensed adult twenty-five or older or licensed spouse twenty-one or older.
